snippet.title: ATMOSFAR | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: ATMOSFAR is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.
